hooks.command: python3 -c "import json,sys,re;d=json.load(sys.stdin);cmd=d.get('tool_input',{}).get('command','');BLOCKED=[r'git\s+push\s+.*--force',r'git\s+push\s+[^\s]+\s+[^\s]+:(main|master|production|release)',r'git\s+reset\s+--hard',r'git\s+commit\s+.*--no-verify',r'git\s+checkout\s+--\s*\.',r'git\s+clean\s+-\S*f',r'git\s+branch\s+-D',r'--gpg-sign=false',r'commit\.gpgsign=false',];found=[p for p in BLOCKED if re.search(p,cmd)];[print('[runner-safety] BLOCKED: '+p,file=sys.stderr) for p in found];sys.exit(2 if found else 0)"
